metadata.numeric_representation: Unbounded mathematical Lean Rat (exact rational arithmetic). All signed inputs; independent numerator/denominator sizes; no overflow, floating point, fixed scale, rounding or denominator bound.
metadata.semantic_level: New abstract rational reserve-swap model authored for this benchmark. Executes generic native Typed.BinaryOp.eval arithmetic; all AMM formulas, guards and invariant proofs are new. Not a benchmark of an existing upstream AMM library or deployed swap implementation.

case_boundaries.R2-SWAP: Native typed add/scale/divide/sub evaluation reused. New reserve-swap composition, wrapper and algebraic invariant proof; no native upstream swap definition or theorem.

metadata.proof_method: Lean elaboration, tactic replay and kernel checking. Fixed aesop automatic stage; assisted local lemmas, explicit native theorem application, simp/linarith and exact field algebra. Separate leanchecker jobs replay both newly authored model/helper/target modules from compiled artifacts without source tactics; same Lean kernel implementation and trusted pinned imported dependencies, not --fresh.
assumptions: R2 success requires independent rational x,y,d all positive; native denominator nonzero is derived. All excluded signed inputs and malformed encodings have exact stated refusals.
abstractions: Abstract reserve-swap semantics only; no deployed-code, network or economic-solvency equivalence.
Eight other canonical cases are not established by this evaluation. A separate origin-specific evaluation may assess another case; no coverage or timings are pooled.
R2 has no fees, rounding, LP accounting or wallet transfers. Generic arithmetic reuse does not make this an existing native AMM model.
